summary: The flux is divided by a log-centred bin width R_c x dlnR instead of the true bin width dR, so the result is no longer the bin average it is declared to be (a few-percent bias in the wide bins).
code_change: New constant DR = CENTER * diff(log(EDGES)); analyse() denom and the period average use DR instead of WIDTH (the truth stays integral / WIDTH).
description_change: measurement spec: normalization convention text appends 'bin width R_c x dlnR (log-centred)'; bin_semantics still bin-averaged.
